## Agent Failed

The lead-scanner agent returned a non-OK status.
Check runtime logs for details.

## No Leads Found

No relevant executive hiring signals detected.
This is normal — not every scan yields leads.

## Leads Created

Slack notifications are sent per-lead by the agent itself.
Nothing else to do here.

Note: Emoji reactions on lead notifications trigger status updates via the existing `/slack/events` endpoint.
